contracts.append: new pages only, actor+album locks, album CAS, source ownership and active record validation; existing cover/title/pages/root metadata preserved; eighty inner page maximum; repeated same selection is idempotent
contracts.reminders: disabled by default; first record required; weekday 1..7 and hour 8..21 KST; one selected time per week, only while there are retained records and no actual save or recap this week; latest opt-in checked again before delivery
contracts.activity: server generated save/create/append events; client UUID idempotent recap/preview/reward allowlist, no notes or image references; ninety-day retention
contracts.metrics: administrator-only aggregate first-save cohort, full fourteen-day or thirty-day observation denominators; no user IDs in results

privacy: Existing published social works use separate immutable page snapshots; appending private album pages does not publish them. Shared album access follows existing explicit collaborator membership and asset bindings.
